AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.2 Optional Driver Release Notes

Last Updated: September 29th, 2026.

Highlights

  • New Game Support
    • Minecraft Dungeons II
    • Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 campaign early access
    • The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
  • Fixed Issues
    • Intermittent driver timeout may be observed while playing Final Fantasy VII Rebirth on Radeon™ RX 7000 series graphics products.
    • Intermittent driver timeout may be observed while playing War Thunder in DirectX 12 mode with Instant Replay and Borderless Region Capture enabled on Radeon™ RX 6000 series graphics products.
    • Anti-Lag 2 may show as inactive in AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition after disabling Frame Generation in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy.
    • Intermittent driver timeout or system freeze may be observed while playing HITMAN™ World of Assassination on Radeon™ RX 9000 series graphics products.

Known Issues

  • Failure to install may be observed while installing AI Bundle components in some regions with limited access to HuggingFace and GitHub.
  • AMD Smart Access Memory may become disabled after driver installation on Windows® 10 systems.
  • Intermittent application crash may be observed while playing Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced on Radeon™ RX 7000 series graphics products.
  • Intermittent driver timeout may be observed while playing War Thunder on Radeon™ RX 5000 series graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to install AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.1.

Additional Information

The AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.2 installation package can be downloaded from the following link:

  • Installing AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition

Radeon Product Compatibility

  • AMD Radeon™ RX 9070 XT
  • AMD Radeon™ RX 9070
